name: SMA 10/30 trend cross
hypothesis: Trends persist long enough for a fast/slow moving-average cross to capture after costs.
falsifier: Negative after fees+slippage out-of-sample, or profit factor < 1.2 OOS, or edge vanishes at +-20% parameters.
data_required: Daily OHLCV CSV (date,open,high,low,close,volume) for the symbol, 5+ years.
